dict.Mutare: tragi stratul ales (se lipește d: Move: drag the selected layer (it snaps to the edges and center of the image and of the other layers; with Ctrl, freely); the arrow keys move it by 1 pixel (Shift: 10)
dict.Foaie de calcul: o foaie dintr-un fișier: Spreadsheet: a sheet from an .xlsx, .ods or .csv file goes into the note as a table, with the formula values calculated
dict.foi. Care intră în notiță?: sheets. Which one goes into the note?
dict.Etape tot mai înguste de sus în jos (de: Stages narrowing from top to bottom (from many to few: visitors, customers)
dict.Momente pe o linie a timpului, cu textul: Moments on a time line, with the text alternating above and below
dict.Legătura feliei se deschide într-o ferea: The slice link opens in a new browser window (tab), and the page with the slices stays open
dict.Bară verticală în stânga textului: Vertical bar left of the text
dict.Schemă: proces, ciclu, piramidă, ierarhi: Diagram: process, cycle, pyramid, hierarchy, Venn, funnel, timeline… Type the items one per line and the diagram goes into the note as a picture (the items are found by search).
dict.Cadru: o poză din calculator umple zona: Frame: a picture from the computer fills the selected area (enlarged to cover it, cut to its shape), on a new layer with a mask
dict.O poză din calculator, pe un strat nou (: A picture from the computer, on a new layer (logo, background, montage); with an area selected, the picture fills it like a frame
dict.Pune textul citit din poză în notiță, la: Put the text read from the picture into the note, at the cursor. Also works for a handwritten ✏ drawing if the letters are legible (handwriting is harder to read than print: check the text).
dict.Textul din poză e pus în notiță, la curs: The text from the picture is in the note, at the cursor.
dict.Fișierul nu pare o imagine pe care o put: The file does not look like a picture we can open (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, SVG, ICO, AVIF, HEIC, PSD, TGA, RAW) or it is damaged.
dict.Fișierul RAW nu are înăuntru o poză JPEG: The RAW file has no JPEG picture inside that we can open (raw sensor data is not developed here).
dict.Poza JPEG din fișierul RAW e deteriorată: The JPEG picture in the RAW file is damaged and cannot be drawn.

templates.Traseul salvat „{0}” e în lista Trasee a: The saved path “{0}” is in the Paths list of the ✒ Path tool.
templates.Cele {0} trasee salvate din fișier sunt: The {0} saved paths from the file are in the Paths list of the ✒ Path tool.
templates.Fișier RAW de aparat foto: s-a deschis p: Camera RAW file: the JPEG picture the camera stored in it was opened ({0}×{1}), not the raw sensor data. Saving gives JPG, PNG, TIFF or another common format.
